name: New JACET List of 8,000 Basic Words (New JACET8000)
creator: JACET Basic Word Revision Committee; distributed via Shin Ishikawa
unit: ranked spelling entry (POS-less; no pre-grouped flemma or family structure)

runtime_processing.payload_at_rest: direct snapshot; no public build artifact

citation: JACET (2016). New JACET List of 8,000 Basic Words.
notes: 2-column CSV: rank,Word. No POS, no inflected forms.
22 entries carry parenthetical variants (e.g. 'mom (mommy, mum, ...)') -> expanded to the head rank.
Spreadsheet artifacts: 'TRUE'/'FALSE' are the words true/false (restored by lower-casing).
A POS-less one-entry-per-spelling list is not thereby flemma-grained. The runtime uses hybrid surface-first lookup and applies the selected normalizer only when a listed spelling is absent.
NJ8.csv is intentionally absent from the public source tree, release archive, container image, CI inventory, and public UI while permission assurance remains review-pending.
